products.title: In Hoc Signo Hoodie
products.description:
Black hoodie with a large Chi-Rho back print framed by the words In hoc signo vinces: "in this sign, conquer." Small cross emblem on the chest.

  • Kangaroo pocket and drawcord hood
  • Screen-printed in white
